title: Add explanatory comment to code regarding constraint.adjust_forces().
body:

Add an explanatory comment to the ``Atoms.get_forces()`` method, explaining the strange logic of checking if the constraint has an ``adjust_potential_energy`` method before calling ``adjust_forces``.  It looks like a buggy test for the method being implemented, since two lines above a similar test is actually a test for the method being implemented.  But it is not, it is a test for whether the method needs to be called even in an MD setting.

This confused me (issue #1889) and may confuse others without a comment.
